assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: one production full-body transparent character portrait for Cosyworld, upgraded ARC at Epic rarity. Image 1 is the new appearance reference (the silver-haired man in the Arc as Archive comic); Image 2 is the old game portrait and defines canvas framing, identity continuity, adult body scale and full-body stance. Use the COMIC's male character only, not the woman, room, speech balloons or title.

Create Arc's upgraded neutral form on a genuinely transparent background, portrait 1024x1536. Exactly one adult man, whole body visible with generous edge padding and feet near the lower baseline. Keep the same slim adult man and recognisable silver-haired identity, roughly the old portrait's relaxed standing three-quarter pose, but soften his face into the comic's thoughtful, warm half-smile. Face toward viewer's RIGHT with torso slightly three-quarter, eyes attentive. Soft tousled silver-white hair, CLEAR BLUE eyes, gently irregular wisps. Outfit from the comic: open-collar ivory white shirt, dark charcoal-brown soft knitted cardigan/jacket, a simple brown-strapped wristwatch. Complete the partially unseen lower outfit with plain dark charcoal trousers and understated brown-black leather shoes. One hand relaxed at his side, other resting casually near trouser pocket. Empty hands, no chess piece, book, weapon or extra props.

Render richly detailed painterly anime-storybook fantasy with fine expressive linework, tactile fabric, warm amber key light and cool blue shadow accents. Preserve the comic's grown-up, approachable presence. Keep the entire head/hair, both hands, legs and both shoes inside the frame with about 7 percent edge padding. Clear readable silhouette suitable for a game sprite. No navy three-piece suit, no tie, no pocket square, no gold chain. NO scenery, floor, shadow puddle, halo, gradient, glow cloud, decorative effect, text, logo, frame or watermark. All surrounding pixels genuinely transparent; keep only the character.
assets.review: Full body inside canvas; same face, blue eyes, outfit and watch as the upgraded neutral master. Empty hands and no scene. Light and dark composite reviewed.

assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: Cosyworld upgraded ARC EPIC combat cutout. Edit target: supplied Arc Epic neutral master. Preserve this SAME adult man's face, proportions, soft tousled silver-white hair, CLEAR BLUE eyes, ivory open-collar shirt, dark charcoal-brown cable-knit cardigan, brown leather watch strap, dark trousers, brown-black shoes and richly detailed painterly anime-storybook finish. Warm amber edge light and subtle cool shadows stay on the character only. Empty hands. No objects, weapons or scarf.

Output ONE full-body sprite on genuinely transparent RGBA background, portrait 1024x1536. Frame entire hair, hands, arms, legs and both shoes inside the canvas. The character's whole height should occupy about 84 percent of canvas, leaving at least 90 pixels transparent padding above hair and below feet. Keep the action compact enough to allow similar side padding. Feet grounded at a consistent baseline near y=1400. No floor or painted shadow. No scenery, black/grey backdrop, halo, glow cloud, text, watermarks, speed lines, duplicates or other people. Clear anatomically coherent hands and limbs. Face and eyes point toward viewer's RIGHT, where the unseen opponent stands; nose visibly points right. Keep hair, clothing and grown-up identity exactly recognisable from the master.

POSE: A compact unarmed STRIKE toward the RIGHT: a small step with the front foot to the right, weight grounded, torso rotating slightly right, rightward arm extending a controlled short punch with clenched empty fist. Other hand guards near chest. Focused, composed determination, not rage. All parts stay comfortably within frame.
assets.review: Full body inside canvas; same face, blue eyes, outfit and watch as the upgraded neutral master. Empty hands and no scene. Light and dark composite reviewed.
